data.summary: I found no errors. Revenue growth of 12.4% and the FY2024 figures match what Amazon reported. Net income growth of 31.1% works with unrounded values (about 31.3% on the rounded ones). The FY2025 cash flow, cash, assets and liabilities look plausible but I couldn't confirm them exactly. The implied rise in equity of about $125B is larger than net income alone would explain and is worth checking against the 10-K.
